verdict.rationale: Rive's docs say coding agents can build Rive files through RML and the CLI, so an agent can produce the production format. Rive's own open-source runtime loads and draws .riv files through a documented Renderer interface. However, no documented programmatic export to screenshots, images or video exists, export is described only as an Editor action, and community users note there is no way to export movie files. Missing for 10: a documented agent-facing render/export API (screenshots, PNG/SVG, video), explicit programmatic .riv export via the CLI or MCP, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can render and export designs — screenshots, images, or production formats — through a documented programmatic surface

citations.quote: making it possible to build Rive files with coding agents and other text-based workflows instead of working exclusively in the Editor
let an agent generate them with the CLI
Loads .riv files, advances state machines and animations, and draws via the abstract Renderer interface.
